text: Psalm 149 Praise the Lord! Sing unto the Lord a new song, and His praise in the assembly of the godly ones.
Let Israel rejoice in its Maker; let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
Let them praise His name with dancing; let them sing praises unto Him with the tambourine and harp.
For the Lord takes pleasure in His people; He will beautify the meek with salvation.
Let the godly ones be joyful in glory; let them sing for joy on their beds.
Let the high praises of God be in their mouths, and two-edged swords in their hands,
to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with shackles of iron;
to execute upon them the written judgment; this is honor for all His godly ones. Praise the Lord!
